signoff_basis.design_complete_rationale: All design-owned acceptance conditions are satisfied. The one remaining item (production real-writes and live-scale human signoff) is a live-activation gate decision, not a design gap. Per blueprint §13 conclusion item 4: the human gate decides whether to activate, not whether the design is allowed to start. Blueprint design work is therefore complete.

blueprint_section_17_ref.note: §17 conditions #9 through #11 are fully satisfied. Condition #12 (production activation) remains a human gate; its resolution does not block blueprint_complete=true.
